description: This file defines a singly linked list data structure with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get by index, along with an internal Node class.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with methods to add, remove, get size, and retrieve elements by index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list; returns true if removal was successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index; throws IndexOutOfBoundsException if index is invalid.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Helper method to unlink a node from the list during removal.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Helper method to find the last node of the list.
